mainEntity.name: Why does self-representation possibility matter at the alone stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because defense and rights issues require calm, precise handling because the wrong response can affect status, deadlines, and later options. Before the next step, self-representation possibility usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.

mainEntity.name: Why does responsibilities without legal assistance matter at the alone stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because immigration matters do not end at approval, because status maintenance, registrations, updates, and later duties can shape what happens next. Before the next step, responsibilities without legal assistance usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
